items.title: GE Vernova and Vineyard Wind Settle $300M-Plus Offshore Wind Dispute

items.title: Why Are BE, FCEL, GEV Stocks Rising Overnight?

items.title: GE Vernova (GEV) Stock Is Up, What You Need To Know
items.summary: Shares of energy transition company GE Vernova (NYSE:GEV) jumped 4.5% in the afternoon session after the company projected strong backlog growth at the Morgan Stanley Laguna Conference, estimating its total order backlog will surpass $200 billion in early 2027.

items.title: GEV Stock Jumps After GE Vernova CEO Touts This Milestone
items.summary: Despite widespread AI concerns, GE Vernova expects to reach a key backlog target sooner than expected. GEV stock jumped on Wednesday. At a Morgan Stanley conference, GE Vernova CEO Scott Strazik reportedly said the company's backlog, which ended the second quarter at $176 billion, is on track to hit $200 billion "very early" in 2027.

items.title: GE Vernova rebounds 6% after earlier sell-off
items.summary: GE Vernova Inc (NYSE:GEV) rebounded with Bernstein’s backing after an earlier sell-off that followed broader concerns about technology infrastructure spending. items.title: GE Vernova Climbs 5% as CEO Sees Backlog Hitting $200B Early; Eaton and Quanta Services Edge Higher
items.summary: GE Vernova's CEO just told a Morgan Stanley conference that the company's most-watched backlog milestone arrives sooner than Wall Street assumed, and the ripple through Eaton and Quanta Services reveals how much of the grid trade hangs on a single demand signal.

items.title: Billionaire Harold Hamm Makes Deal to Explore for Venezuela Oil
items.summary: Billionaire shale pioneer Harold Hamm’s Continental Resources Inc. reached a deal for an oil field in Venezuela as the Trump administration pushes US companies to revive the nation’s oil sector.
